tasks.short: Assess financial health and future performance using financial records, forecasts and operating assumptions.

steps.what: Retrieve financial balances, cash positions and operating forecasts.
Reconcile extracts and align periods, currencies and account mappings.
Examine profitability, liquidity, working capital and forecast deviations.
Model scenarios and select assumptions worth challenging.
Challenge operating assumptions and agree plausible responses.
Write the financial assessment and explain material changes.

loop.input: Validated scenario tables, agreed assumptions and recorded management explanations.
loop.output: Draft financial assessment with references to table cells and assumption records.
loop.check: Check every amount against calculated tables; flag unsupported explanations for analyst review.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass per assessment; unresolved claims become blanks for the analyst.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle figures, but explanations vary with free-text operating context.

steps.what: Approve the financial outlook and recommend management action.

tasks.design: Scheduled integrations reconcile {ERP}, {BANK} and {CRM} data in the {DATA_PLATFORM}, then feed financial indicators and deterministic scenarios into {BI}. A bounded drafting loop prepares commentary in {DOCS} from validated figures and recorded explanations; the finance manager approves the outlook and recommendations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Account mappings, forecast definitions and spreadsheet models differed between teams. Maintaining integrations often cost more than each reporting cycle justified.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reporting configuration and faster integration development reduce setup effort. A bounded model loop can draft explanations without calculating financial results.
tasks.still_hard: Forecasts depend on uncertain demand, payment behaviour and management responses. Reliable data lineage and confidential access remain necessary.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when historical patterns no longer apply and challenging optimistic assumptions without losing business cooperation.

ambition.what: A weekly downside-liquidity review with named intervention triggers.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from assembling figures to testing scenarios and challenging business assumptions. The manager can refresh scenarios within the planning remit; formal investment and financing approval rights do not change.

reach.learn: Driver selection, sensitivity analysis and forecast backtesting.
Cash timing, facility availability and liquidity buffers.

evidence.claim: Bank and finance data can support cash forecasts and comparisons against actuals; this supports the cash component only.
Reconciliation, financial ratios and scenario calculations can use deterministic rules; selecting assumptions remains judgement.

assumptions: The initial scope covers one reporting perimeter and a limited set of financial scenarios.
Step shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured outcomes.
The consent and access range covers permissions and consultation screening; formal consultation under national rules may extend elapsed delivery time.
unknowns: Which systems provide usable exports or interfaces?
Are account mappings, exchange-rate conventions and forecast definitions agreed?
How much reconciliation and scenario preparation time does the manager actually spend?
Will any proposed data use trigger employee consultation under national rules?
research_questions: Which indicators give actionable warning before cash or margin deteriorates?
Can historical forecasts be reconstructed well enough to test scenario quality?
new_work: Resolve reconciliation exceptions and maintain mappings.
Review drafted explanations against source figures.
Backtest forecasts and retire misleading indicators.
Maintain access permissions and integration alerts.

tasks.short: Approve or reject credit facilities and loans within delegated lending authority.

steps.what: Retrieve the validated application, credit assessment and existing exposure.
Review repayment prospects, security, policy exceptions and proposed terms.
Route the recommendation to the required approval level.
Discuss material risks, exceptions and conditions where committee review is required.
Approve, reject or defer the facility and record reasons and conditions.
Send the approved decision notice and record delivery.

tasks.design: Configure the lending records system in {OTHER} and {WORKFLOW} to assemble decision packs, route by delegated authority and record decisions. Human approvers assess credit and approve the exact notice; {EMAIL} sends only that approved version to a verified recipient and records delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approval limits, exceptions and committee records were scattered across documents and mail. The financial decision itself was often treated as inseparable from its administrative routing.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned approval rules, structured decision records and existing workflow configuration can handle routing and paperwork. No model is required for this design.
tasks.still_hard: Credit judgement, security enforceability and concentration risk remain substantive work. GDPR, the EU AI Act and national lending rules require scope-specific assessment, particularly for natural-person creditworthiness.
tasks.human_edge: Taking responsibility for uncertain repayment prospects and weighing an exception against portfolio risk.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time chasing approvals and more time assessing unusual exposures and conditions. Lending limits and formal decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Debt-service analysis, security quality and evidence-based credit reasoning.
Connected exposures, sector concentration and stress losses.

evidence.claim: Delegated-authority routing, versioned approval records and approved-template notifications can be configured deterministically.
Significant decisions about natural persons require assessment under GDPR Article 22; meaningful human review cannot be a rubber stamp.
Natural-person creditworthiness assessment can fall within the EU AI Act's high-risk scope.

assumptions: This lending task applies to a mid-size lender or a company with a genuine lending activity; it is usually absent from ordinary corporate finance.
The loan origination or servicing system is represented by {OTHER}.
Shares represent a mixed caseload; committee review is conditional and its time is averaged across cases.
The originating credit assessment is supplied by the application-processing task rather than repeated here.
Step shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
Access estimates include legal and consultation screening; required procedures under national rules may extend elapsed delivery time.
unknowns: Does the company lend, and which loan or credit products are in scope?
Which decisions need individual, dual or committee approval?
Can the lending records system enforce authority limits and approved-notice versions?
Are applicants businesses, natural persons or both?
Which national lending and employee consultation rules apply?
research_questions: Can every approval route be expressed as an auditable decision table?
Which conditions must block notice release or later disbursement?
new_work: Maintain authority limits and approval substitutions.
Investigate stalled or incorrectly routed decisions.
Audit that notices match approved decisions and recipients.
Review access rights and decision-record completeness.

tasks.short: Prepare, approve and release financial reports for regulators and the board.

steps.what: Confirm reporting requirements, deadlines, scope and material judgements.
Retrieve closed balances, reconciliations and supporting schedules.
Map balances into report schedules and check totals and comparatives.
Investigate validation exceptions and document accounting treatments.
Assemble the report and write disclosures and financial commentary.

loop.input: Validated schedules, required disclosure checklist, approved accounting notes and report template.
loop.output: Draft narrative sections with references to schedule rows and accounting notes.
loop.check: Validate amounts deterministically and check disclosure coverage; an analyst reviews interpretation and wording.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass per section; missing evidence produces a flagged gap.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables and fixed wording use templates; variable explanations require reading accounting notes.

steps.what: Approve the exact report version, destination and release timing.
Submit approved filings or distribute approved board packs.
Archive the released report, supporting evidence and delivery receipt.

tasks.design: A deterministic generator on the {DATA_PLATFORM} maps closed {ERP} balances into validated schedules and report templates in {DOCS}. A bounded loop drafts variable narrative from approved accounting notes, while {WORKFLOW} records sign-off on the exact report and release destination. Supported interfaces deliver approved filings through {GOV_PORTAL} or board packs through {DOCS}, then archive receipts and source references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report layouts, account mappings and supporting evidence were maintained separately. Automation was brittle when requirements or accounting treatments changed.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned mappings, reusable report templates and automated validation reduce repeated assembly. Faster coding lowers the cost of maintaining a narrow reporting generator.
tasks.still_hard: Material accounting judgements and changing reporting requirements need expert interpretation. Unsupported filing interfaces retain a manual submission step, and automation cannot substitute for the required signatory.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining material uncertainty, choosing defensible accounting treatments and accepting responsibility for the released report.

ambition.what: A board reporting pack with a source trail for every reported financial amount.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends more time on material disclosures and board questions, with less report assembly and evidence chasing. Statutory and board approval rights remain with existing signatories.

reach.task: Prepare supporting schedules and accounting disclosures.
reach.learn: Reporting mappings, close controls and materiality.
Data lineage, versioned definitions and access controls.

evidence.claim: Financial report tables, cross-checks and source indexes can be generated with deterministic mappings and templates.
Variable reporting narrative can be drafted from approved notes, but disclosure completeness and accounting judgement need human review.

assumptions: The first release covers one report family, one reporting perimeter and established accounting policies.
Shares average the applicable release branch; a report is not necessarily both filed and sent to the board.
The filing automation estimate assumes a supported submission interface; otherwise submission stays manual.
The authorised report signatory reviews and approves the release in step s6.
Step shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
Access work includes confidential-data controls, GDPR screening and consultation screening under national rules.
unknowns: Which reports, jurisdictions and signatories are in scope?
Are source balances closed and supporting schedules reconciled?
Which filing destinations support automated submission and reliable receipts?
What evidence retention and access requirements apply?
Does the proposed data use require employee consultation under national rules?
research_questions: Which validation failures would prevent an incorrect but internally balanced report?
Can each material disclosure be linked to an approved evidence record?
new_work: Maintain reporting templates, mappings and disclosure checklists.
Review narrative and investigate validation exceptions.
Test changed reporting requirements against prior reports.
Monitor submissions and resolve missing or rejected receipts.

tasks.short: Process loan applications and prepare evidence-based credit assessments for authorised decision makers.

steps.what: Register the application and attach submitted evidence in the {OTHER} lending records system.
Read submitted documents and extract financial and applicant facts.

loop.input: Submitted financial statements, income evidence, application fields and evidence requirements.
loop.output: Proposed application fields with page references and explicit missing or conflicting values.
loop.check: Validate types, dates and arithmetic relationships; the analyst confirms material fields against source pages.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass per document; unreadable or conflicting evidence goes to the analyst.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use direct field imports where available; varied document layouts and prose need bounded extraction.

steps.what: Calculate repayment ratios, exposure and credit-policy flags.
Request missing or inconsistent evidence from the applicant.
Assess repayment prospects, evidence quality and policy exceptions.
Discuss material anomalies and proposed financing needs with the applicant.
Finalise the assessment and submit it through the {OTHER} lending records system.

tasks.design: Configure intake and evidence checklists in the {OTHER} lending records system, with documents in {DOCS}. A bounded extraction loop proposes sourced fields; deterministic calculations produce ratios and policy flags, and {WORKFLOW} prepares evidence requests for review. The credit analyst assesses repayment prospects and approves the assembled assessment before it enters the separate credit-approval process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicants supplied varied documents, and analysts retyped figures into separate calculation sheets. Exceptions and evidence requests were difficult to express as a single fixed form.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured intake removes avoidable rekeying, while bounded document extraction handles the remaining varied evidence. Calculations and completeness checks remain ordinary rules.
tasks.still_hard: Extracted facts do not establish authenticity or future repayment capacity. GDPR, the EU AI Act and national lending rules constrain personal-data use and any later move into automated creditworthiness assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguishing a weak document trail from a weak borrower and recognising explanations that require further corroboration.

ambition.what: A pre-application evidence-readiness checklist for small-business borrowers.

tasks.altitude: The analyst spends less time transcribing documents and more time investigating repayment risks and speaking with applicants. The finance manager receives a more consistent assessment; final credit authority remains in the separate approval task.

reach.learn: Document provenance, corroboration and escalation thresholds.
Cash-flow normalisation, debt-service calculations and policy exceptions.

evidence.claim: Document extraction can propose sourced fields while deterministic calculations handle ratios and completeness checks.
A human decision gate must provide meaningful review where significant natural-person decisions engage GDPR Article 22.
Loan processing is a specialist lending activity and is not normally part of ordinary corporate finance management.

assumptions: This task applies only where the company originates or administers loans.
The initial scope covers one loan product and a limited set of evidence types.
Missing-evidence requests and applicant calls are conditional; their shares are averaged across applications.
Supplementary evidence repeats the same extraction and validation controls before use.
Extraction does not generate a credit score or make an approval or rejection decision.
Step shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
Consent and access work includes GDPR assessment, document-processing permissions and consultation screening; required national procedures may extend elapsed delivery time.
unknowns: Which loan products and applicant groups are actually handled?
What share of evidence arrives as structured fields versus documents?
Which repayment calculations and evidence requirements are approved?
Can the lending records system accept reviewed fields with source references?
What privacy, retention, national lending and employee consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Which extraction errors could materially change a repayment assessment?
Which evidence types require independent verification rather than document reading?
Can an approved checklist identify gaps before applicants submit a formal application?
new_work: Review material extracted fields and resolve conflicting evidence.
Maintain evidence requirements and calculation rules.
Monitor extraction failures across document types and languages.
Investigate authenticity concerns and preserve the evidence trail.

role.altitude: The finance manager's week shifts toward financial interpretation, scenario challenge and accountable approval. Better preparation supports faster investigation and discussion; formal reporting, financing and lending authorities remain with their designated holders.
reach: Budget analyst: driver-based forecasting and forecast backtesting.
Treasurer: liquidity headroom and cash timing.
Accountant: reporting controls, accounting judgements and disclosure evidence.
Credit analyst: repayment capacity and defensible credit recommendations, where lending applies.
skills_to_grow: Define financial metrics, mappings and validation rules.
Test scenarios and distinguish calculated outputs from uncertain assumptions.
Review sourced model outputs and investigate exceptions.
Maintain approval controls, data lineage and confidential access.
Communicate material uncertainty and challenge business assumptions.
role.ambitious_version: Run a weekly financial resilience review with traceable figures, downside scenarios and explicit intervention triggers, while offering the board source-linked reporting. Where the company lends, add applicant evidence-readiness support and consistent credit packs under existing approval authority.
